title: Signal Local Server Host Comparison Demo

launch.notes: Runs the existing signal-host-local and signal-host-server binaries, records one bounded comparison receipt, and emits a rendered operator companion without redesigning host output.

scenarios.title: Local Versus Server Bootstrap Comparison
scenarios.summary: Compares the existing local and server host bootstrap surfaces through their current summary lines, without redesigning either binary output.

evidence.notes: This comparison surface wraps the current host binaries and captures their shared runtime and recovery posture while adding a rendered operator companion without widening into plugin browsing or a host UI shell.

known_exclusions: Plugin capability browsing remains deferred to a later g09.012 planning decision.
Hardware topology and diagnostics demos remain deferred.
This demo compares the existing host summary outputs and does not redesign those outputs.
expected_checks: Both host binaries boot successfully on their real CLAP path.
Both hosts report ready and running posture with one active sandbox.
Both hosts report completed bounded execution with processed blocks and heartbeat responses.
The rendered companion view makes shared lifecycle truth and local-versus-server differences visually inspectable without reading the raw receipt first.
The receipt keeps local-versus-server differences explicit instead of flattening them.
